payload.summary: Transferred the public repository to vxu-labs/dip and updated package identity and install URLs. Added cross-worktree worker visibility, locally waiting claims, normalized scope exclusion and non-destructive installer preflight. 35 unit/integration tests completed (33 passed, two POSIX-only skips on Windows); browser navigation/mobile and clean package installation passed. Discovery now targets new candidates instead of rescanning roots on known source renames. Release awaits CI for the current organization-owned revision.
payload.next: Validate organization CI and create the v0.1.0 release with a current package.
